6: # yt-dlp Video Downloader Skill
7: 
8: This skill provides tools for downloading videos and extracting audio from various platforms using yt-dlp.
9: 
10: ## Features
11: 
12: - Download videos from multiple platforms (YouTube, Twitter/X, Vimeo, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, etc.)
13: - Extract audio from videos
14: - Auto-detect video URLs in conversations
15: - Support for different quality settings and formats
16: 
17: ## Usage Patterns
18: 
19: ### 1. Command-based Download
20: 
21: When user explicitly asks to download a video:
22: ```
23: User: Download this video https://youtube.com/watch?v=...
24: ```
25: 
26: **Action**: Extract URL and call download script
27: 
28: ### 2. Auto-detection in Conversations
29: 
30: When conversation contains video URLs:
31: ```
32: User: Check out this video https://twitter.com/... and let me know what you think
33: ```
34: 
35: **Action**: Detect video URL, ask user if they want to download it
36: 
37: ### 3. Audio Extraction
38: 
39: When user wants to extract audio only:
40: ```
41: User: Extract the audio from https://youtu.be/...
42: ```
43: 
44: **Action**: Use audio extraction script

46: ## Available Scripts
47: 
48: Note: Scripts are located in the `scripts/` directory

50: ### download_video.py
51: 
52: Main video downloader with quality and format options.
53:

55: ```bash
56: # Download video
57: scripts/download_video.py <url> -o <output_dir>
58: 
59: # Download with specific quality
60: scripts/download_video.py <url> --quality 720p
61: scripts/download_video.py <url> --quality audio  # For audio only
62: 
63: # Custom format selector
64: scripts/download_video.py <url> --format "bestvideo[height<=1080]+bestaudio/best"
65: 
66: # Extract info only
67: scripts/download_video.py <url> --info-only
68: ```
69: 
70: **Quality options**: `best`, `1080p`, `720p`, `480p`, `audio`
71: 
72: ### extract_audio.py
73: 
74: Extract audio from videos in various formats.
75: 
76: **Usage**:
77: ```bash
78: # Extract as MP3 (default)
79: /scripts/extract_audio.py <url> -o <output_dir>
80: 
81: # Extract as M4A
82: /scripts/extract_audio.py <url> --format m4a
83: 
84: # Custom quality
85: /scripts/extract_audio.py <url> --quality 320
86: ```
87: 
88: **Formats**: `mp3`, `m4a`, `opus`, `flac`, `wav`
89: 
90: ### extract_urls.py

93:

100: /scripts/extract_urls.py <file_path>
101: 
102: # Read from stdin
103: cat file.txt | /scripts/extract_urls.py
104: ```

106: ## Video Platform Support
107: 
108: The skill recognizes URLs from:
109: - YouTube (youtube.com, youtu.be)
110: - Twitter/X (twitter.com, x.com)
111: - Vimeo (vimeo.com)
112: - TikTok (tiktok.com)
113: - Instagram (instagram.com)
114: - Facebook (facebook.com, fb.watch)
115: - Twitch (twitch.tv, clips.twitch.tv)
116: - Dailymotion (dailymotion.com)
117: - Reddit (reddit.com)
118: - Streamable (streamable.com)
119: - And many more supported by yt-dlp
120: 
121: ## Workflow
122: 
123: ### When User Provides Video URL
124: 
125: 1. Extract URL from user's input using `extract_urls.py`
126: 2. Confirm with user what action to take:
127:    - Download video
128:    - Extract audio
129:    - Show video info
130: 3. Execute appropriate script based on user's choice
131: 4. Notify user of success/failure and file location
132: 
133: ### When Auto-detecting URLs
134: 
135: 1. Scan conversation text with `extract_urls.py` (can process stdin)
136: 2. If video URLs found, ask user: "I found video URLs in this conversation. Would you like me to download them?"
137: 3. If yes, proceed with download workflow
138: 4. If no, continue with conversation
139: 
140: ### Handling Multiple URLs
141: 
142: - For single URL: Direct download
143: - For multiple URLs: Ask user if they want to download all or select specific ones
144: - Provide option to download as playlist if URLs are from the same source
145: 
146: ## Quality and Format Selection
147: 
148: When user doesn't specify preferences:
149: - Default to best available quality
150: - For audio: Default to MP3 at 192kbps
151: 
152: When options needed:
153: ```bash
154: # Ask user for quality preference if not specified
155: # Options: best (default), 1080p, 720p, 480p, audio
156: 
157: # Ask for format if extracting audio
158: # Options: mp3 (default), m4a, opus, flac, wav
159: ```
160: 
161: ## Error Handling
162: 
163: Common issues and solutions:
164: 
165: 1. **yt-dlp not installed**:
166:    - Check with `yt-dlp --version`
167:    - Install with `pip install yt-dlp` or `brew install yt-dlp`
168: 
169: 2. **ffmpeg not installed** (required for format conversion):
170:    - Install with `brew install ffmpeg` (macOS)
171:    - Or `apt install ffmpeg` (Linux)
172: 
173: 3. **Video not available**:
174:    - Check if URL is accessible
175:    - Some videos may require authentication
176:    - Age-restricted content may need cookies
177: 
178: 4. **Network errors**:
179:    - Retry download
180:    - Check internet connection
181: 
182: ## Dependencies
183: 
184: - `yt-dlp`: Main video downloader
185: - `ffmpeg`: Audio/video processing (required for format conversion)
186: - `python3` with standard library
187:
